The University of Michigan School of Information (UMSI) in Ann Arbor, MI, invites applicants for the University of Michigan Presidential Postdoctoral Fellowship Program (PPFP). Faculty at UMSI have a successful record of providing a nurturing and productive postdoctoral experience for Presidential Postdoctoral Fellows. In keeping with the PPFP program, UMSI seeks applicants whose research, teaching, and service will, as determined by the University of Michigan and in accordance with law, contribute to the core values of the University of Michigan, and to equal opportunity in higher education. Candidates will be evaluated on fit with current needs and strengths of the institution and future funding possibilities.

UMSI is particularly interested in candidates whose work focuses on aspects of privacy and technology, with a particular interest in how privacy intersects with AI. We define privacy broadly, and welcome applications from researchers approaching privacy through technical, policy, design, ethical, and/or social lenses.

UMSI views these postdoctoral fellowships as providing an exceptional opportunity to recruit new faculty to the university and we expect PPFP positions to lead to a tenure-track faculty appointment at UMSI.

Applicants to UMSI must submit their application materials to UMSI by September 20, 2026 and to the PPFP Office by November 1, 2026.
